# orchestration_retry_tool

> Retry a stage in a workflow execution that has failed or is stuck.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_retry_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Retry a stage in a workflow execution that has failed or is stuck.

Use this when a stage didn't complete and needs to run again — e.g. a
SiloLink stage whose session went silent, or a stage that errored. It
tears down the dead attempt and starts a fresh one immediately,
regardless of the template's automatic retry limit.

By default it retries the execution's current stage; pass
stage_execution_id to target a specific one.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orchestration_execution_id` | integer | yes | The workflow execution ID whose stage should be retried. |
| `stage_execution_id` | integer | no | Optional. The specific stage execution to retry. Defaults to the current stage. |
